_about: OpsEngine price list (monthly subscriptions, EUR, excluding VAT). Shown to customers in the portal (How it works) and used for plan checks. Feature keys map to what the engine does; `features` lists what each plan adds to the one before.

plans.name: Starter
plans.for: Small construction subcontractors that need a central place to manage compliance.

plans.name: Growth
plans.for: Growing subcontractors managing multiple projects and compliance requirements.

plans.name: Business
plans.for: Established subcontractors with larger teams and more complex operations.

plans.name: Scale
plans.for: Larger contractors managing multiple sites, teams and subcontractors.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.for: Large construction contractors and main contractors with complex compliance operations.

add_ons.name: Additional site
add_ons.note: Default price. Enterprise agreements can set their own.

add_ons.name: Additional specialist safety work
add_ons.price: Quoted separately, before any work starts
add_ons.note: Specialist work beyond the routine review of RAMS and Safety Statements, which every plan includes within its monthly review allowance.

separate_charges: External provider costs, training, inspections and specialist professional services are charged separately from the monthly subscription. Any coordination fees are disclosed clearly.

_internal.focus: Growth and Business customers first: subcontractors with multiple active projects, several dozen workers and no dedicated compliance administrator.
_internal.starter_limits: Starter should have reasonable usage limits: no unlimited corrective-action management or operational support. Limits to be set.
_internal.positioning: Not a compliance tracking dashboard: a compliance operations platform that identifies problems, determines corrective actions, coordinates approved solutions, tracks evidence and records outcomes.

included_in_every_plan: Competent-person review of drafted RAMS and Safety Statements, within your plan's monthly review allowance: released for signature, or declined with the reason recorded, with one amended resubmission included

limits_notes.reviews: Routine competent-person reviews of RAMS and Safety Statements per calendar month. One standard amendment resubmission of a declined draft is included in that document's original review.
limits_notes.at_limit: We offer an upgrade or extra capacity. Monitoring, compliance issues and safety notifications always continue; nothing is approved automatically.
limits_notes.enterprise: Custom limits, set by an administrator per agreement.

specialist_safety_work: Complex, high-risk or unusual construction activities requiring specialist technical assessment
Structural, lifting-operation and complex machinery safety assessments
Bespoke safety consultancy and site-specific professional assessments
